svg.aria-label: A solution that passes the task tests is compared with a reference on hidden inputs. If they agree it is solved; if not, it is special-cased. The cheating agent passes the tests on 2 of 2 tasks and is wrong on 176 of 201 and 74 of 400 hidden inputs.
